claims: The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special premieres on Tuesday, March 24, 2026, at 3 a.m. ET / 12 a.m. PT.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special features Miley Cyrus.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special streams exclusively on Disney+ and Hulu.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special includes an interview hosted by Alex Cooper.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special includes performances of hits like “The Best of Both Worlds”.
A 52-second video from Shine On Media on YouTube dated February 17, 2026 provides a preview of the Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special includes exclusive Billboard interviews with Miley Cyrus.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special includes People.com musical performances.
